clue.text: Jacket for a midshipman

definitions.meaning: a short double-breasted jacket of thick cloth, as worn by sailors
old naval slang for a junior officer, from the job of taking in sail aloft

explanation.surface: A tailor asks what coat suits a young naval officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are naval: a close-fitting sailor's coat, and the nickname for a young officer who reefed sails.

clue.text: Rice about to be raised under a tree

parts.note: the elm is a tree

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means read upwards, so the word for about runs backwards

parts.note: RE means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Grains of rice lie beneath a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: Elmer Rice was an American playwright; 'under' places the tree first in a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The American dramatist Rice had this forename.

clue.text: In the first, place, it stands for Germany's anti-Russian line

parts.note: for, as in a symbol that stands for something
the Eastern Front, written E FRONT, was Germany's line against Russia

explanation.surface: A historian explains what Germany's eastern battle line represented first of all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the' is a link: 'in the forefront' means 'in the first place'.
explanation.definitionFit: The leading position or foremost part is the prime spot.

clue.text: Several decades go to 'make this flower-garden

definitions.meaning: a string of prayer beads made up of decades, sets of ten

explanation.surface: Several decades of work go into a rose garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The Catholic prayer beads are grouped in tens, and the same word once meant a bed of roses.

clue.text: Anticipate timing for an office appointment

definitions.meaning: to date a cheque or document ahead of the actual day, anticipating it
the date of appointment to a post, read as two words

explanation.surface: Looking forward to the hour set for a meeting at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Office appointment' is a meeting in the surface, but cryptically it is appointment to an office, a POST, and its timing is the DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dating a cheque ahead of time anticipates the day; split in two, the word is the date one takes up a post.

clue.text: Soldier has professional business that's outside National Service

parts.note: a private is a soldier of the lowest rank
a doctor's or lawyer's business is a practice

explanation.surface: A private soldier runs a sideline away from his military duties.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the National Health Service: doctors working outside it are in private practice; 'National Service' was Britain's conscription.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical work done for fees rather than within the state health system.

clue.text: Daily pitfalls found in some hot spots

parts.note: the Sun is a British daily newspaper
traps are pitfalls

explanation.surface: Everyday dangers are found in some trouble spots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daily' looks like an adverb but is a noun, a newspaper: The Sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheltered sunny places are warm spots.

clue.text: Fear the adder can create

indicators.note: what the snake's letters can create, rearranged, is another word

explanation.surface: Fear what a snake might do.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is great fear.

clue.text: No end of a follower of Lao-tse, each Irish leader

indicators.note: no end means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a Taoist follows the teachings of Lao-tse

explanation.surface: Every follower of the Chinese sage has no limit, says an Irish leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No end of' cuts the final T from TAOIST. The Taoiseach is the Irish prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The Taoiseach is the Irish prime minister.

clue.text: The effect of a reprint

definitions.meaning: the mark or feeling something leaves on the mind
a further printing of a book from the same type

explanation.surface: A publisher wonders what a second printing achieves.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a lasting effect on someone and a reissue or printing run of a book.

clue.text: Mythical divinity lurking in Prospero's island

indicators.note: something lurking in a phrase sits concealed within its letters, here those of the magician's name

explanation.surface: A classical god hides out on the island ruled by the magician of The Tempest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lurking in' says the god is concealed in PROSPERO'S; 'island' merely completes the Tempest picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of love is a divinity of myth.

clue.text: Involve university teacher or graduate

annotationWithheld.why: Clue printed 'Involve university teacher or graduate' (3,5); wordplay PROF + OR + MA is sound but the page's 'Involve' is a misprint for 'Invoice', so no printed word defines PRO FORMA

clue.text: Plant is hard to replace

indicators.note: replacing the letters of 'is hard' means setting them in a new order

explanation.surface: A gardener finds a certain plant is difficult to substitute.
explanation.definitionFit: A pungent root vegetable is a plant grown in gardens.

clue.text: Deceptive character of one silver ring described as ancient

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
AG is the chemical symbol for silver
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A two-faced villain wears an old silver ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'described as ancient' is a nod to Othello, where the villain is called 'ancient', an old word for ensign.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's villain in Othello is the archetype of a deceiver.

clue.text: Fielding's character was thoroughly estimable.

parts.note: all, as in all over or completely
worthy means estimable

explanation.surface: A character in a Fielding novel was a thoroughly good man.
explanation.walkthrough: Squire Allworthy is Tom's benevolent guardian in Fielding's Tom Jones.
explanation.definitionFit: The good squire in Tom Jones is named for his virtue.

clue.text: Exceptional opening for eager constable

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, taken from 'eager'

parts.note: a special constable is a volunteer police officer, a 'special' for short

explanation.surface: A keen policeman gets an outstanding chance.
explanation.walkthrough: A SPECIAL is a British volunteer part-time police officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Especial is an old-fashioned synonym of particular or outstanding.

clue.text: Cheer on 'Reformed Church for being consistent

indicators.note: reformed means formed anew, so the letters of 'Cheer on' are rearranged

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Supporters cheer the Reformed Church for its consistency.
explanation.definitionFit: Coherence is the quality of holding together logically.

clue.text: Drink gets a note in feature article

indicators.note: in means the a and the note are placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: a chin is a facial feature
A is the indefinite article
TE is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A drink has an annotation within a feature article.
explanation.definitionFit: A black tea grown in the Far East is a beverage, so the type of leaf names a kind of refreshment.

clue.text: Arrow-maker was nominally Christian

definitions.meaning: a craftsman who fits feathers to arrows
Christian by name: the Bounty mutineer's first name

explanation.surface: An archer's supplier claims to have been a churchgoer in name only.
explanation.definitionFit: The trade name for a maker of arrows is also the forename of Christian, leader of the mutiny on the Bounty.

clue.text: Fence two hectares

indicators.note: two of something means the one piece repeated

parts.note: HA is the abbreviation for hectare

explanation.surface: A farmer fences off a couple of hectares.
explanation.walkthrough: A ha-ha is a sunken fence or ditch bounding a park, invisible from the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunken ditch serving as a boundary is a kind of fence.

clue.text: Showed feelings by returning keys to me

indicators.note: returning means the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: D and E are musical keys

explanation.surface: Someone became emotional when keys were given back to them.
explanation.definitionFit: To emote is to display emotion.

clue.text: Standard article by Montagu?

parts.note: a norm is a standard
AN is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A model piece written by an author named Montagu.
explanation.walkthrough: Montagu Norman was Governor of the Bank of England (1920-44), so the name that goes 'by Montagu' is his surname; the question mark flags the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: The banker's surname followed his forename, so this name stands beside the other one.

clue.text: This bird sounds under-age.

indicators.note: sounds signals that the word is said aloud

parts.note: a minor is under age

explanation.surface: This bird sounds young.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pronunciation MINOR and MYNAH sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: The mynah is an Asian starling known for mimicry.

clue.text: Welshman in extreme old age

definitions.meaning: a native of Wales, from the Latin name of the country
the geological period beginning over 500 million years ago

explanation.surface: A man from Wales reaches a great age.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means Welsh, from the Latin Cambria, and names the earliest period of the Palaeozoic era.

clue.text: Darling dog turned up about noon in Scotland

indicators.note: about means placed around, so noon is inside
turned up in a down clue means read upwards

parts.note: Nana is the Darling family's dog in Peter Pan

explanation.surface: A beloved dog showed up around midday in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Darling' looks like an endearment but is the family in Peter Pan. Annan is a town in south-west Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Annan is a town in Dumfriesshire, so it is a place in Scotland.

clue.text: College point-to point

parts.note: E, east, a compass point
N, north, another compass point

explanation.surface: A school known for its steeplechase meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a horse race; here the points are compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous English public school is formally a college.

clue.text: Number of articles accepted by new minister

definitions.text: Number of articles accepted by new minister

parts.words: Number of articles accepted by new minister
parts.note: the Church of England's doctrinal statement, assented to by clergy at ordination, has this many articles

explanation.surface: How many clauses must a newly ordained clergyman agree to?
explanation.definitionFit: Anglican clergy historically assented to the Articles of Religion, numbering this many.

clue.text: The GLC has a year's start to make entrance to churchyard

indicators.note: the letters given are used to make something new, a rearrangement

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: London's council has a year to build a gateway to the churchyard.
explanation.walkthrough: The GLC was the Greater London Council. 'to make' rearranges THEGLC, A and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofed gateway to a churchyard, where a coffin once waited for the clergyman.

clue.text: Governess expected girl back

parts.note: due means expected

indicators.note: back means the girl's name is read from right to left

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A governess was expecting the girl to return.
explanation.definitionFit: An older woman who acts as chaperone or governess to girls in a Spanish family.
